name: write-issue
description: Write or revise Jira epics and issues from discussion, not guesses: ask before drafting, keep undecided things as open questions, a fixed epic format, who to show the work to, and linking new epics from the team roadmap. Also writes Chap and Open Geo Service ideas in the DHIS2 Roadmap (ROADMAP) project, and handles action points in the Climate team task tracking (CTI) project: adding them, capturing them from pasted or linked meeting notes, listing and closing them.
